data._note_500hz_included: 500Hz is now in training so the model sees real 500Hz IQ statistics. Deployment is consecutive frames (step=1, dt=2ms), forced by frequency_step_overrides.

frequency_step_overrides._note: Force step=1 for 500Hz data: dt = 1 x 0.002s = 2ms (consecutive frames). This exactly matches the deployment scenario. The GT is temporally resampled to the dense output grid. 5kHz/10kHz/20kHz use the normal augmentation_steps above. Does not affect extra_data_dirs samples (PVA is labeled 10kHz, not 500hz).

data._note_extra_data_dirs: v13 adds PVA phantom data to training (previously unused). Only PVA's own 'train' split (40 samples) is used here -- its 'val' split (10 samples) is deliberately NOT loaded, so it stays held-out for a fair, leakage-free comparison against v10b/v12 (which never saw any PVA data) on the exact same PVA val samples used in prior evaluation. PVA has a different ROI crop size (72x200) than fullscale_velocity (116x160), so its batches are trained via InterleavedBatchLoader (src/training/train_wavepinn_v10.py) -- shape-homogeneous per batch, interleaved with fullscale batches at the batch level, never mixed within a batch.

training._note: Same recipe as v12/v10b (loss weights, LR, epochs, gates unchanged). v13 differs only in adding PVA phantom training data via extra_data_dirs -- everything else (dt-fix backbone, leakage-free fullscale split) is inherited unchanged from v12.
